#en: Weapons ready, please and thanks.
zh: 武器就绪，多谢。

#en: Looks like our weapons are ready!
zh: 看来武器都就绪了！

#en: Warning: Combat protocols active.
zh: 警告：战斗协议已激活。

#en: Alright, stand by. Let me just...
zh: 好，稍等。我这就……

#en: Sending down a mechanical friend!
zh: 给你送个机械朋友下去！

#en: I could've done this without you.
zh: 没你我也能办成。

#en: I hope you're up for some mining.
zh: 希望你有兴致挖矿。

#en: It was nothing we couldn't handle.
zh: 这点小事难不倒我们。

#en: Alright, let's check in with Gren.
zh: 好，去跟格伦联系一下。

#en: It's Watchtower! They've found us!
zh: 是瞭望塔！他们找到我们了！

#en: There you go, free from all vices.
zh: 好了，你的毛病都清了。

#en: Everything now where it should be.
zh: 一切都归位了。

#en: Is this the Cyberamp you're after?
zh: 这就是你要的赛博增幅吗？

#en: Shall I get started on extracting?
zh: 要我开始提取吗？

#en: I've changed my mind. Forget this.
zh: 我改主意了。这事算了。

#en: Sounds like what happened to me...
zh: 听起来跟我当年一样……

#en: No, I just want to modify my ship.
zh: 不，我只想改装我的飞船。

#en: What happened after you left Neon?
zh: 你离开霓虹城之后发生了什么？

#en: Fair enough. So, back to business?
zh: 有道理。那么，继续说正事？

#en: Take look, most of its even fresh!
zh: 看看吧，大半还是新的！

#en: Now! Anything I can help you with?
zh: 好了！有什么我能帮你的吗？

#en: These Neuroamps, what can they do?
zh: 这些神经增幅器有什么用处？

#en: Hope you've got room for one more!
zh: 希望你还有位置再装一个！

#en: Eridani's waiting. You good to go?
zh: 波江座在等着呢。可以出发了吗？

#en: Huh, you're right! How about that?
zh: 咦，你说得对！还真没想到。

#en: Understood, I'll set a course now.
zh: 明白，我这就设定航线。

#en: Well, I suppose that answers that!
zh: 嗯，这就算回答了！

#en: Why do they consider me dangerous?
zh: 他们为什么觉得我危险？

#en: Target is in range. Let's do this.
zh: 目标已进入射程。动手吧。

#en: I hope you like mud on your boots.
zh: 希望你不介意靴子上沾泥。

#en: Hang tight, this'll keep 'em busy!
zh: 稳住，这个能拖住他们！

#en: Where can I find more Intel Slates?
zh: 我上哪儿找更多情报数据板？

#en: We need to do something about this.
zh: 我们得想个办法。

#en: Still, let's see what I can find...
zh: 不过，还是看看我能找到什么……

#en: Do you have issues with Watchtower?
zh: 你跟瞭望塔有过节吗？

#en: That should handle your dependency.
zh: 这样应该能解决你的依赖问题。

#en: Does this Cyberamp suit your needs?
zh: 这个赛博增幅合你要求吗？

#en: I've time, tell me the whole thing.
zh: 我有时间，把整个经过讲给我听。

#en: Actually, I'm no longer interested.
zh: 其实，我没兴趣了。

#en: Let me extract the relevant data...
zh: 让我提取相关数据……

#en: Have you salvaged the ships I sent?
zh: 我派去的那些船你拆解了吗？

#en: Sure! There anything else you want?
zh: 当然！还想要别的吗？

#en: Okay, then. Anything else you need?
zh: 那好吧。还需要别的吗？

#en: Who is this "friend" you mentioned?
zh: 你说的那个「朋友」是谁？

#en: Is there anything you DO wanna do?!
zh: 那你到底想不想干点什么？！

#en: You gonna give me a peek or not...?
zh: 你到底给不给我看一眼……？

#en: Warning: Connection error detected.
zh: 警告：检测到连接错误。

#en: Well, now that's been dealt with...
zh: 嗯，这事算是处理完了……

#en: Okay, that's the first. Keep going!
zh: 好，第一个搞定。继续！

#en: Starting atmospheric descent now...
zh: 开始大气层下降……

#en: Here's your flare. One more time...
zh: 你的信号弹。再来一次……

#en: Here's your flare! See you outside!
zh: 你的信号弹！外面见！

#en: We can take care of this ourselves.
zh: 这事我们自己能办。

#en: Welcome to Stardock Omega... Again.
zh: 欢迎来到星坞奥米伽……又来了。

#en: How did Watchtower find me, anyway?
zh: 瞭望塔到底是怎么找到我的？

#en: Systems go! We're ready for launch!
zh: 系统就绪！可以发射了！

#en: Cannons are ready to fire, Captain!
zh: 火炮准备就绪，舰长！

#en: Ready and at your command, Captain.
zh: 准备就绪，听你命令，舰长。

#en: A "cracking algorithm", what's that?
zh: 「破解算法」，那是什么？

#en: You've no past beef with Watchtower?
zh: 你以前跟瞭望塔没仇？

#en: I'm unsure I can adequately explain.
zh: 我不确定能否解释清楚。

#en: If not, I can always offer you mine.
zh: 如果没有，我随时可以借你我的。

#en: Think this Amp could serve you well?
zh: 觉得这个增幅对你有用吗？

#en: Alright, we'll try something else...
zh: 好，那我们试试别的……

#en: We don't have enough cores for that.
zh: 我们的核心不够。

#en: Now, was there something you needed?
zh: 那么，你需要什么吗？

#en: I hope my answers were satisfactory.
zh: 希望我的回答让你满意。

#en: Alright, let's hear what you've got.
zh: 好，说说你有什么。

#en: Can you tell me more about Stardock?
zh: 能多讲讲星坞吗？

#en: What are you after? A meal, a drink?
zh: 你想要什么？吃的，还是喝的？

#en: Hand it here and I'll get to work...
zh: 交给我，我这就动手……

#en: Toss it here and I'll take a look...
zh: 扔过来，我看看……

#en: Not done yet! Still need more power!
zh: 还没完！还需要更多电力！

#en: Let's head back to <Alias=Stardock>.
zh: 我们回<Alias=Stardock>吧。

#en: Ready to jump to the Eridani system?
zh: 准备好跃迁到波江座星系了吗？

#en: Can you remind me of our plan again?
zh: 能再提醒我一遍我们的计划吗？

#en: Any more information on Eridani III?
zh: 关于波江座III还有更多情报吗？

#en: Some guy told me to meet him here...
zh: 有个家伙让我来这儿见他……

#en: Let's blast them back into the void!
zh: 把他们轰回虚空！

#en: Roger, roger. Combat Flare detected.
zh: 收到，收到。检测到战斗信号弹。

#en: Watchtower technology self-destructs?
zh: 瞭望塔的技术会自毁？

#en: Consider it done. We'll be back soon!
zh: 包在我们身上。我们很快回来！

#en: We're on it! Catch you later, Harper!
zh: 我们这就去！回头见，哈珀！

#en: Probably not as much as you'd prefer.
zh: 大概没你希望的那么多。

#en: Heh, guess Harper's got places to be.
zh: 嘿，看来哈珀有事要忙。

#en: That should do it. Back in one piece.
zh: 这样应该就行了。完好如初。

#en: What happened to the Watchtower ship?
zh: 那艘瞭望塔的飞船怎么了？

#en: I want to know more about Watchtower.
zh: 我想多了解一些瞭望塔的事。

#en: How did you and Torin become friends?
zh: 你和托林是怎么成为朋友的？

#en: Please confirm this is what you want.
zh: 请确认这就是你要的。

#en: A new Skydrop ready for installation.
zh: 新空投已可安装。

#en: [3 Watchtower Components] Supply Drop
zh: [3 瞭望塔部件] 补给空投

#en: Fair enough. Was there anything else?
zh: 有道理。还有别的事吗？

#en: We'll begin working on your ship now.
zh: 我们现在开始处理你的飞船。

#en: We'll handle your ship modifications.
zh: 你的飞船改装我们来办。

#en: These are the Skydrops I can build...
zh: 这些是我能建造的空投……

#en: I want to unlock a different Skydrop.
zh: 我想解锁另一个空投。

#en: This decryption may take some time...
zh: 解密可能要花些时间……

#en: That was all, I've no more questions.
zh: 就这些，我没别的问题了。

#en: Just got fresh stock! Take your pick.
zh: 刚到的新货！随便挑。

#en: So long, drones. You won't be missed.
zh: 再见了，无人机。没人会想你们。

#en: Don't forget your flare! We got this.
zh: 别忘了你的信号弹！我们能行。

#en: And here we are at sunny Eridani III!
zh: 我们到阳光明媚的波江座III了！

#en: What's this...? Some sort of grenade?
zh: 这是什么……？某种手雷？

#en: I don't have time for this right now.
zh: 我现在没空管这个。

#en: Another excellent choice, my Captain!
zh: 又一个绝佳选择，我的舰长！

#en: I know you'll get a kick out of this!
zh: 我知道你会喜欢这个！

#en: Ignore the beeping noises. It's fine.
zh: 别管那些哔哔声。没事。

#en: *crunch* You got it, just a second...
zh: *嘎吱* 没问题，稍等……

#en: You'll have support in just a moment.
zh: 支援马上就到。

#en: Some advice? You need to be careful...
zh: 给你个建议？你得小心点……

#en: Sounds doable! Thanks as always, Gren.
zh: 听起来可行！一如既往地感谢你，格伦。

#en: Intel is Harper's specialty, not mine.
zh: 情报是哈珀的专长，不是我的。

#en: Relax! I told you, Gren's on our side.
zh: 放松！我说过，格伦是我们这边的。

#en: Hm. I thought you'd want to know more.
zh: 嗯。我还以为你想多了解一些。

#en: Repairs underway. Shouldn't take long.
zh: 正在维修。不会太久。

#en: I don't think I want to hear any more.
zh: 我想我不想再听了。

#en: Thanks, but I think I've heard enough.
zh: 谢谢，不过我听够了。

#en: Do you have a problem with what I did?
zh: 你对我做的事有意见？

#en: I'll have to remember that strategy...
zh: 这招我得记住……

#en: Receiving data on my end. Let's see...
zh: 我这边正在接收数据。看看……

#en: Good to be back. Shall we get started?
zh: 回来真好。我们开始吧？

#en: Well aren't you a sight for sore eyes!
zh: 看到你可真让人高兴！

#en: I see your call for a combat assist...
zh: 我看到你的战斗支援请求了……

#en: I'll comply, I don't want any trouble.
zh: 我配合，我不想惹麻烦。

#en: [Attack] I'll blast you outta the sky!
zh: [攻击] 我把你轰下天！

#en: This seems like it was a waste of time.
zh: 这看来是白费工夫。

#en: Is Watchtower surveilling every system?
zh: 瞭望塔在监视每一个星系吗？

#en: We'll do our best! You can count on us.
zh: 我们会尽全力！你可以指望我们。

#en: What is this station we're on, exactly?
zh: 我们所在的这座空间站到底是什么？

#en: How did you survive your ship crashing?
zh: 你的飞船坠毁了，你是怎么活下来的？

#en: Take better care of yourself next time.
zh: 下次多照顾照顾自己。

#en: I'll take whatever can give me an edge.
zh: 只要能让我占优势的，我都要。

#en: [Unlock Cyberamp] Yes, I want this Amp.
zh: [解锁赛博增幅] 对，我要这个增幅。

#en: Watchtower has infiltrated governments?
zh: 瞭望塔渗透了政府？

#en: Just to be sure, this is what you want?
zh: 确认一下，这就是你要的吗？

#en: No need, your ship's in fine condition.
zh: 不用，你的飞船状况良好。

#en: Give me a moment to extract the data...
zh: 给我一点时间提取数据……

#en: Let me plug in and see what comes up...
zh: 让我插上看看能找到什么……

#en: Need me to dig into some Intel for you?
zh: 需要我帮你挖点情报吗？

#en: Don't keep me waiting, let's have it...
zh: 别让我等，拿来吧……

#en: Mind giving me a lift back to Stardock?
zh: 能捎我回星坞吗？

#en: ...Here we go! Time for some fireworks!
zh: ……开始了！该看烟花咯！

#en: Dialing in my approach. Clear the area!
zh: 正在校准进近。清空区域！

#en: And here comes our mechanized friend...
zh: 我们的机械化朋友来了……

#en: We're in! Facility's cracked wide open!
zh: 进去了！设施彻底敞开了！

#en: Still crashing your ship into the mech?
zh: 你还是要拿飞船去撞机甲？

#en: No one could survive a crash like that!
zh: 那样的坠毁没人能活下来！

#en: Hmph, why does that not surprise me...?
zh: 哼，我怎么一点都不意外……？

#en: I... kinda already was. But okay! Um...
zh: 我……其实已经是了。不过好吧！呃……

#en: Let me know how that works out for you.
zh: 祝你顺利，记得告诉我结果。

#en: Unleashing hell in three... two... run!
zh: 三……二……放地狱了！快跑！

#en: Warned you about what? Did you mess up?!
zh: 警告你什么？你搞砸了？！

#en: How did you discover the Listening Post?
zh: 你是怎么发现监听哨的？

#en: I'd like to know more about you, Harper.
zh: 我想多了解你一些，哈珀。

#en: Huh. There were no complications at all?
zh: 哦。一点波折都没有？

#en: No pressure. These things can take time.
zh: 别有压力。这种事急不来。

#en: Go ahead. Curiosity never killed anyone.
zh: 问吧。好奇害不死人。

#en: Any more problems, come back and see me.
zh: 再有问题，回来找我。

#en: Cured and clean! Let's keep it that way.
zh: 治好了，干干净净！保持这样。

#en: Let's check you haven't broken anything.
zh: 我看看你有没有伤到哪儿。

#en: Very well. Do you require anything else?
zh: 很好。你还需要别的吗？

#en: Your Skydrops will be restocked shortly.
zh: 你的空投很快会补满。

#en: What more can you tell me about Cydonia?
zh: 关于塞多尼亚你还能告诉我什么？

#en: Do you mind if I ask you some questions?
zh: 介意我问你几个问题吗？

#en: [1 Watchtower Component] Surface Missile
zh: [1 瞭望塔部件] 地表导弹

#en: No problem, we'll just modify your ship.
zh: 没问题，我们改装你的飞船就是了。

#en: [3 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Supply Drop
zh: [3 计算机核心] 空投 - 补给空投

#en: Is this the Skydrop you wish to acquire?
zh: 这是你想获取的空投吗？

#en: [Give Intel] I've found some more Intel.
zh: [交出情报] 我又找到了一些情报。

#en: Telemetry's coming through. Analyzing...
zh: 遥测数据已收到。分析中……

#en: Sure, okay. Just don't leave me hanging!
zh: 行，好。别让我干等！

#en: Any questions before we kick things off?
zh: 开始前有问题吗？

#en: Ready to head out to the Eridani system?
zh: 准备前往波江座星系了吗？

#en: Let's do this. Ready to jump to Eridani?
zh: 动手吧。准备跃迁到波江座？

#en: You travel the stars, huh? I can relate.
zh: 你在星际间旅行，是吧？我能理解。

#en: Weapon's looking right as rain, Captain!
zh: 武器状态好得很，舰长！

#en: Drop inbound. Watch yourself down there.
zh: 空投即将抵达。下面小心点。

#en: Someone needs to offer me an explanation.
zh: 得有人给我个解释。

#en: [Upgrade Cyberamp] Yes, upgrade this Amp.
zh: [升级赛博增幅] 对，升级这个增幅。

#en: Is this the one you'd like me to extract?
zh: 这是你想让我提取的那个吗？

#en: Reloading your Skydrop modules. Stand by.
zh: 正在为你的空投装填。请稍候。

#en: Skydrops will be replenished momentarily.
zh: 空投马上就会补充完毕。

#en: I don't want to build anything right now.
zh: 我现在不想建造任何东西。

#en: [1 Watchtower Component] Bot Drop - Shiva
zh: [1 瞭望塔部件] 机器人空投 - 湿婆

#en: These are the Skydrops I can fabricate...
zh: 这些是我能制造的空投……

#en: That's doable. Shall I proceed with this?
zh: 可以办到。要我继续吗？

#en: A visitor to my workshop. How delightful.
zh: 有客人来我的工坊。真难得。

#en: I assume you found something interesting?
zh: 我想你找到了些有趣的东西？

#en: [Hand in Intel] Here's the slate I found.
zh: [递交情报] 这是我找到的数据板。

#en: Scan the planet with your ship's sensors.
zh: 用飞船传感器扫描这颗行星。

#en: I thought my plan was pretty good, but...
zh: 我以为我的计划挺好的，不过……

#en: Alright. Hold on... I'm taking the shot!!
zh: 好。稳住……我要开炮了！！

#en: Making my approach into the atmosphere...
zh: 正在进入大气层……

#en: Hah! We sure can. Well, let's do it then!
zh: 哈！当然能。那就动手吧！

#en: But I didn't expect them to have MECHS...
zh: 但我没想到他们有机甲……

#en: I'm ready. Let's get this fleet hardware.
zh: 我准备好了。去弄这套舰队硬件。

#en: Don't keep me in suspense, let's hear it!
zh: 别卖关子，说来听听！

#en: Let's show these guys what we're made of!
zh: 让这帮家伙看看我们的本事！

#en: Let's hope it doesn't bite us in the ass.
zh: 但愿这事别反咬我们一口。

#en: Yeah, good to see you too! You blockhead.
zh: 是啊，见到你我也很高兴！你这木头。

#en: Just tell us where this Listening Post is.
zh: 直接告诉我们这监听哨在哪儿。

#en: Could you tell me a little about yourself?
zh: 能简单介绍一下你自己吗？

#en: And as for his... "colorful" appearance...
zh: 至于他那个……「花哨」的外表……

#en: Oh, yeah. "Better". Not unsettling at all.
zh: 哦，是啊。「好多了」。一点都不瘆人。

#en: Hah. That's a... That's a good question...
zh: 哈。这……这问题问得好……

#en: Shall we proceed with extracting this Amp?
zh: 要开始提取这个增幅吗？

#en: Changed your mind, have you? No problem...
zh: 改主意了，是吧？没问题……

#en: Very well. You are, as they say, the boss.
zh: 很好。俗话说，你说了算。

#en: Tell me more about your own modifications.
zh: 多讲讲你自己的改装。

#en: Bear in mind, this will consume resources.
zh: 提醒你，这会消耗资源。

#en: Okay. Just tell me which Skydrop you want.
zh: 好。告诉我你要哪个空投就行。

#en: Stand by while I calibrate my equipment...
zh: 稍等，我校准一下设备……

#en: [2 Watchtower Components] Bot Drop - Miner
zh: [2 瞭望塔部件] 机器人空投 - 矿工

#en: [3 Watchtower Components] Bot Drop - Medic
zh: [3 瞭望塔部件] 机器人空投 - 医疗

#en: Are you sure this is the Skydrop you want?
zh: 你确定要这个空投吗？

#en: Power's still low! Breaker switches, ASAP!
zh: 电力还是不够！快去扳开关！

#en: Anyway, c'mon, let's get back to Stardock.
zh: 总之，走吧，我们回星坞。

#en: But I think we're done now. So, off we go!
zh: 我觉得现在完事了。那就出发吧！

#en: Hahaha. And it wouldn't be the first time.
zh: 哈哈哈。又不是第一次了。

#en: Made it! Now, where's that Node hiding...?
zh: 到了！那个节点藏在哪儿呢……？

#en: And that's the last to 'em! Good riddance.
zh: 这是最后一个了！总算清静了。

#en: Need to clear anything before we move out?
zh: 出发前还有什么事要办吗？

#en: Where were you? I could've used your help.
zh: 你跑哪儿去了？我还指望你帮忙呢。

#en: Ha! Nice work! Now we've got a way inside.
zh: 哈！干得好！现在我们能进去了。

#en: Don't worry, we've not been made! Not yet.
zh: 别担心，我们还没暴露！暂时没有。

#en: How does Skydrop get us into the facility?
zh: 空投怎么把我们送进设施？

#en: What happens if Watchtower captures me...?
zh: 如果瞭望塔抓住我，会怎样……？

#en: Before anything else, tell me who you are.
zh: 先别急着别的，告诉我你是谁。

#en: Be advised that this is now a combat zone.
zh: 特此告知，此处现为交战区。

#en: Need an Armillary down there? Standy by...
zh: 下面需要浑天仪吗？请稍候……

#en: Ugh, damn it. Another ship is jumping in!
zh: 呃，该死。又一艘船跃迁进来了！

#en: Always glad when I can make an appearance!
zh: 能露个面我总是很高兴！

#en: Not sure l'll visit more Listening Posts...
zh: 我不确定还会不会再去别的监听哨……

#en: Spit it out, already! I don't have all day.
zh: 痛快点说！我可没一整天。

#en: No. But I imagine you might find it useful.
zh: 不。但我想你可能觉得它有用。

#en: Welcome back! Found yourself a second ship?
zh: 欢迎回来！给自己找了第二艘船？

#en: That was fast. Were there not any problems?
zh: 这么快。没遇到什么麻烦？

#en: Do you mind if I ask about your appearance?
zh: 介意我问问你的外表吗？

#en: I hope talking like this is better for you.
zh: 希望这样说话对你更舒服。

#en: You didn't really answer HOW you escaped...
zh: 你其实没回答你是怎么逃出来的……

#en: Cyberamps? Can you tell me more about them?
zh: 赛博增幅？能多讲讲吗？

#en: Honestly, this almost feels like surgery...
zh: 说实话，这几乎像做手术……

#en: Nevermind, I don't want anything right now.
zh: 算了，我现在什么都不要。

#en: Here, take this Slate and see for yourself.
zh: 来，拿着这块数据板自己看。

#en: I've got a few things on hand. Take a look.
zh: 我手头有些东西。看看吧。

#en: Before you joined Watchtower, who were you?
zh: 你加入瞭望塔之前是谁？

#en: You'll need more credits to cover the cost.
zh: 你的钱不够付这笔费用。

#en: I'll get your vessel patched up right away.
zh: 我马上把你的飞船修好。

#en: [5 Watchtower Components] Surface Cryo Bomb
zh: [5 瞭望塔部件] 地表冷冻炸弹

#en: [5 Watchtower Components] Bot Drop - Combat
zh: [5 瞭望塔部件] 机器人空投 - 战斗

#en: [1 Watchtower Component] Surface Smoke Bomb
zh: [1 瞭望塔部件] 地表烟雾弹

#en: [3 Watchtower Components] Surface EMP Blast
zh: [3 瞭望塔部件] 地表电磁脉冲

#en: These are the current Skydrops available...
zh: 这些是目前可用的空投……

#en: We can do that. Are you sure you want this?
zh: 可以办到。你确定要这个？

#en: You know what, let's forget this for now...
zh: 这样吧，这事先算了……

#en: Alright, switch number two. Two more to go!
zh: 好，第二个开关。还剩两个！

#en: What more can you tell me about Watchtower?
zh: 关于瞭望塔你还能告诉我什么？

#en: Sorry, Flare's in a bad spot, so no can do!
zh: 抱歉，信号弹位置不好，办不到！

#en: We got a live one! Prep for incapacitation!
zh: 有个活的！准备制服！

#en: Who are you? You have no authority over me.
zh: 你是谁？你无权管我。

#en: Sure, just point me in the right direction.
zh: 行，只要给我指个方向。

#en: Oh. Oh, crap... Gren warned me about this...
zh: 哦。哦，糟糕……格伦警告过我这事的……

#en: What sort of data are Watchtower collecting?
zh: 瞭望塔收集的是哪类数据？

#en: And now we can build up a fleet again! Nice.
zh: 现在又能重建舰队了！不错。

#en: Hmm. Acceptable condition... Should suffice.
zh: 嗯。状况尚可……应该够用。

#en: Um... Torin? Should we be worried right now?
zh: 呃……托林？我们现在该担心吗？

#en: I'm sorry, you've not enough credits to pay.
zh: 抱歉，你的钱不够付。

#en: I'll admit, I was, and still am intrigued...
zh: 我承认，我当时很好奇，现在也是……

#en: Here's the dataslate. You know what to do...
zh: 这是数据板。你该知道怎么做……

#en: ...Now, where did I put that Vacuum Tape...?
zh: ……我把那卷真空胶带放哪儿了……？

#en: On second thought, give me the fast version.
zh: 我再想想，还是说简短版吧。

#en: I'm sorry, you lack the credits for repairs.
zh: 抱歉，你的钱不够付维修费。

#en: Let's get your ship back into working order.
zh: 我们把你的飞船修复如初。

#en: I see. Well then, tell me what you'd prefer.
zh: 明白了。那么，告诉我你想要什么。

#en: You've made your selection. Are you certain?
zh: 你已经选好了。确定吗？

#en: [1 Computer Core] Skydrop - Bot Drop - Shiva
zh: [1 计算机核心] 空投 - 机器人空投 - 湿婆

#en: Understood. Are you ready for me to proceed?
zh: 明白。要我继续吗？

#en: If you want. Just don't make it weird, okay?
zh: 你想问就问。别搞得很怪，行吗？

#en: Lookin' for some help with Watchtower Intel?
zh: 需要人帮你处理瞭望塔情报？

#en: Let's chat once these drones are dealt with.
zh: 等这些无人机收拾完了我们再聊。

#en: Pins and needles? Hah, yeah. Yeah, I know...
zh: 坐立不安？哈，是啊。是啊，我懂……

#en: Drones eliminated. That's one less headache.
zh: 无人机已清除。少了个麻烦。

#en: If you wanna spearhead this, I'm all for it!
zh: 你想挑头办这事，我完全赞成！

#en: That's right! Take the lead and I'll follow.
zh: 没错！你带头，我跟着。

#en: We need to get that Fleet-Sync Control Node.
zh: 我们得拿到那个舰队同步控制节点。

#en: You travel? What sort of profession is that?
zh: 你到处旅行？这算什么职业？

#en: Which, by the way, you are most welcome for!
zh: 顺便说一句，不用谢！

#en: I don't buy that. Everything has a weakness.
zh: 我不信。万物皆有弱点。

#en: Sit tight. Sending some high-explosive help!
zh: 坐稳了。给你送点高爆支援！

#en: I'm not going to let Watchtower hunt me down.
zh: 我不会让瞭望塔追捕我。

#en: Time to check in with Gren! You know the way.
zh: 该去联系格伦了！你知道路。

#en: Won't Watchtower know it was us who did this?
zh: 瞭望塔不会知道是我们干的吗？

#en: What's your goal here? Why ask me to do this?
zh: 你的目的是什么？为什么让我来做？

#en: So, you have no prior issues with Watchtower?
zh: 所以，你以前跟瞭望塔没矛盾？

#en: Sweet! Our fleet strategy's back in business!
zh: 太好了！我们的舰队战略又能运转了！

#en: Well, I'd feel guilty if I damaged any of it!
zh: 我要是弄坏了它，会良心不安的！

#en: And just like that, Harper takes her leave...
zh: 就这样，哈珀告辞了……

#en: Actually, I'd like to extract something else.
zh: 其实，我想提取别的东西。

#en: Shall I refine this model with some new data?
zh: 要我用新数据改进这个型号吗？

#en: That's fine by me. What's your new choice...?
zh: 我没意见。你的新选择是……？

#en: Here's the credits from the ships I salvaged.
zh: 这是我拆解飞船换来的钱。

#en: What does Watchtower want? What's their goal?
zh: 瞭望塔想要什么？他们的目的是什么？

#en: Sure, I'll fix your ship up. Won't take long.
zh: 行，我来修你的飞船。不会太久。

#en: What is the new Skydrop you want constructed?
zh: 你要建造的新空投是哪个？

#en: Okay, I'll start assembling the components...
zh: 好，我开始组装部件……

#en: [10 Watchtower Components] Bot Drop - AI Mech
zh: [10 瞭望塔部件] 机器人空投 - AI机甲

#en: [5 Watchtower Components] Surface Bombardment
zh: [5 瞭望塔部件] 地表轰炸

#en: [2 Watchtower Components] Turret Drop - Laser
zh: [2 瞭望塔部件] 炮塔空投 - 激光

#en: Here's a slate with the available Skydrops...
zh: 这是可用空投的数据板……

#en: [3 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Bot Drop - Medic
zh: [3 计算机核心] 空投 - 机器人空投 - 医疗

#en: [2 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Bot Drop - Miner
zh: [2 计算机核心] 空投 - 机器人空投 - 矿工

#en: Hold on, I'll begin the extraction process...
zh: 等等，我开始提取……

#en: Your choice, though! I won't keep you. Later!
zh: 随你选！不耽误你了。回见！

#en: You're going out of your way to help me. Why?
zh: 你这么费心来帮我。为什么？

#en: Just a moment, and I'll extract what I can...
zh: 稍等，我尽量提取……

#en: Let's see what secrets we've got this time...
zh: 看看这次能挖到什么秘密……

#en: Alright, let's see what we're working with...
zh: 好，看看我们手头有什么……

#en: Looks like our mech buddy decided to show up.
zh: 看来我们的机甲老兄决定露面了。

#en: I'm ready. We're going to Eridani III, right?
zh: 我准备好了。我们去波江座III，对吧？

#en: This universe seems a lot like the old one...
zh: 这个宇宙跟原来那个很像……

#en: Then I better avoid Watchtower as best I can.
zh: 那我最好尽量避开瞭望塔。

#en: If that kills you I call dibs on your corpse.
zh: 这要是弄死你，你的尸体归我。

#en: Sending down a metal friend to even the odds!
zh: 送个金属朋友下去帮你扳回局面！

#en: Deploying hardware. Stay alive 'til it lands!
zh: 正在投送装备。撑到它落地！

#en: My search pattern is complete. Shutting down.
zh: 搜索模式已完成。正在关闭。

#en: [Signal Torin] Wait, hold on just a minute...
zh: [呼叫托林] 等等，稍等一下……

#en: I fully intend to bring you more Intel Slates.
zh: 我打算给你带更多情报数据板。

#en: They did catch us off guard, but we were okay.
zh: 他们确实打了我们个措手不及，但我们没事。

#en: With that out of the way, welcome to Stardock!
zh: 那事解决了，欢迎来到星坞！

#en: We can manage that. Appreciate the help, Gren!
zh: 我们能办到。谢谢帮忙，格伦！

#en: That's okay, I don't want a Skydrop right now.
zh: 不用了，我现在不需要空投。

#en: Congratulations. You now have an active fleet.
zh: 恭喜。你现在有一支现役舰队了。

#en: Wait. "On our side", what do you mean by that?
zh: 等等。「我们这边」，你是什么意思？

#en: Hey, where'd you go! We got things to discuss.
zh: 嘿，你去哪儿了！我们有事要谈。

#en: Repairs would be pointless, there's no damage.
zh: 没有损伤，维修没意义。

#en: Let me grab a few things, and we'll proceed...
zh: 让我拿点东西，我们就开始……

#en: [5 Watchtower Components] Surface Inferno Bomb
zh: [5 瞭望塔部件] 地表炼狱炸弹

#en: [3 Watchtower Components] Surface Laser Cannon
zh: [3 瞭望塔部件] 地表激光炮

#en: These cores can be complex, but I'll manage...
zh: 这些核心可能很复杂，但我能搞定……

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface Cryo Bomb
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表冷冻炸弹

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Bot Drop - Combat
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 机器人空投 - 战斗

#en: [3 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface EMP Blast
zh: [3 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表电磁脉冲

#en: [1 Computer Core] Skydrop - Surface Smoke Bomb
zh: [1 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表烟雾弹

#en: Actually, I don't want to do this right now...
zh: 其实，我现在不想做这个……

#en: Skydrop hit its mark! Facility's ready for us.
zh: 空投命中目标！设施已为我们打开。

#en: Are you sure the Advocate can do this instead?
zh: 你确定辩护者能做这事？

#en: Tell me more about Skydrops. How do they work?
zh: 多讲讲空投。它们怎么运作？

#en: Hah! Oh, man. You, hah, you do NOT wanna know!
zh: 哈！哦，天。你，哈，你绝对不想知道！

#en: Watchtower, huh? Good to have a name for them.
zh: 瞭望塔，嗯？总算有个名字了。

#en: Great time for a little field testing, right?!
zh: 正是做点实地测试的好时机，对吧？！

#en: So there's a lot of Listening Post out there...
zh: 外面还有很多监听哨……

#en: That depends on your definition of "trouble"...
zh: 那取决于你怎么定义「麻烦」……

#en: I'm curious how the Fleet Command System works.
zh: 我很好奇舰队指挥系统怎么运作。

#en: That was fast. I assume there were no problems?
zh: 这么快。我想没有麻烦吧？

#en: Why are you still wearing a Watchtower uniform?
zh: 你为什么还穿着瞭望塔的制服？

#en: You've not met him yet... So, maybe I should...
zh: 你还没见过他……所以，也许我该……

#en: Let's take a look at your ship's configuration.
zh: 我们看看你的飞船配置。

#en: Fine by me. Just confirm, and I'll get started.
zh: 我没意见。确认一下，我就开始。

#en: Sure, that's manageable. Ready for me to begin?
zh: 行，可以办到。要我开始了？

#en: Stand by while I retrieve the necessary data...
zh: 稍等，我调取必要的数据……

#en: As you wish. Can I help you with anything else?
zh: 如你所愿。还有别的需要我帮忙吗？

#en: What? You got somewhere to be? Tch, whatever...
zh: 怎么？你还有别处要去？啧，随便……

#en: I'm not in the mood for chatter, make it quick.
zh: 我没心情闲聊，快说。

#en: Time to see where Watchtower's been snooping...
zh: 该看看瞭望塔在哪儿偷偷摸摸了……

#en: C'mon! Let's get a move on. Stardock's waiting.
zh: 走吧！我们快点。星坞等着呢。

#en: And there's our mechanical welcoming committee.
zh: 我们的机械迎宾团来了。

#en: System locked. Missile loaded. Skydrop inbound!
zh: 系统锁定。导弹装填。空投来袭！

#en: Let's get the Control Node! Eridani III awaits!
zh: 去拿控制节点！波江座III在等着！

#en: Alright. I'll wait for you here. Don't be long!
zh: 好。我在这儿等你。别太久！

#en: Once we arrive at Eridani III, what's the plan?
zh: 到了波江座III之后，计划是什么？
